note: Wooded Irish Hills campground off US-12 (16230 US-12, Cement City), the former Irish Hills Campground reopened under new family ownership as a quiet, faith-based family park: alcohol and marijuana are not permitted. Most sites take full slide-outs. Fishing and kayaks on Nature Lake and Otto's Pond; near Michigan International Speedway. --Claude
summary: Operator's site + CampLife: 2026 rates back-in $50 / pull-through $55 (confirmed; weekly and holiday rates added to fees.note), full hookups with 30/50 amp at every site (electric 50 new, water/sewer confirmed), 41 RV sites with pull-throughs (count new), showers/flush toilets/laundry (new), booked on CampLife (platform/url new; motorhome is an offered equipment type). CampLife gave no quote (park not open on any date tried, 2027 not loaded), so no hidden per-night fee could be checked. Presence passes (working site with phone 800-646-2023, which matches; booking engine). Price gate: base $50 is at, not over, US$50; no gateway within 40 km (nearest Detroit 108 km); the family has not stayed. Long-stay: nightly in character (weekly rate offered, no seasonal-only sites). Waterfront claim flagged. Note trimmed of field restatements.
flags: Waterfront re-audit lead: the operator advertises 'Waterfront Views & Outdoor Recreation ... access to beautiful natural water ... Nature Lake and Otto's Pond' and 'Scenic waterfront areas'; the entry is 'not waterfront', and CampLife has a 'Water-front' amenity defined (attached to the cabin type only).

Price gate: the 2026 base (back-in $50) sits exactly on the US$50 line (pull-through $55 is over); CampLife could not quote, so any mandatory per-night fee is unchecked. No gateway within 40 km; not a family stay.
